title: Crypto hardware wallet owners face fresh security risks after recent spate of personal data thefts | TechCrunch
summary: The crypto wallet makers provided their customers’ names, home addresses, email addresses, and phone numbers to the shipping companies for mailing out their hardware wallets. Zack Whittaker is the security editor at TechCrunch.
